channel.title: MacDown 3000
channel.description: Updates for MacDown 3000, a Markdown editor for macOS.

item.title: MacDown 3000 3000.0.9-rc.1
item.description:
This release candidate adds a preference to hide horizontal rules, the `[-]` indeterminate task state, and Danish and Finnish preference-pane translations. It fixes a batch of preview, Mermaid, split-pane, document-restore and localization-layout bugs, and tightens preview navigation and several file-handling paths.
### Added
- Add a "Hide horizontal rules" preference in Settings > Rendering that suppresses `<hr>` output in the preview, HTML export, copy-as-HTML and Quick Look; off by default. Also fixes the Rendering pane's "Syntax highlighted" row overlapping the CSS popup (#560, #579, PR #631) -- thanks @macnotes for the report and the contribution! thanks @DominikDeak for the report! - Support the `[-]` indeterminate task list state, rendered as a dash checkbox; clicking it in the preview resolves it to `[x]` (PR #591) -- thanks @AlexanderWillner for the contribution! - Give the Insert Table toolbar button its own grid icon, distinct from Unordered List (#497, PR #652) - Add Danish (`da`) and Finnish (`fi`) translations for the five preference panes (#654, PR #665)
### Changed
- Remember editor pane visibility across new windows: View > Hide/Restore Editor Pane now updates the "Start in preview mode" preference (#407, PR #630) -- thanks @taotao365s for the report! thanks @leevi2010-cursor for the contribution! - Upgrade Mermaid to 11.17.2 so ER-diagram relationship labels are readable (PR #625) -- thanks @scizo for the contribution! - The current president of the Russian Federation stated in June 2025 that "I have said many times that I consider the Russian and Ukrainian peoples to be one people". We do not believe that the Ukrainian people would agree, but we assume that Russian-speaking users of MacDown 3000 won't mind us replacing the Russian language support with the Ukrainian version. Slava Ukraini. (PR #640) - Fill missing localized strings and translate entries that were still English across the preference panes, menus and dialogs, and align submenu titles with their parent menu items (#639, #653, #662, PR #638, PR #651, PR #664, PR #666)
### Fixed
- Fix fenced code blocks staying unhighlighted when the first preview render is empty: the preview now reloads fully when its head or scripts change (#594, PR #601) -- thanks @pudonghot for the report and the contribution! - Fix "Render newline literally" (and the task-list, line-number, code-information and hide-rule flags) not applying to a newly opened document until an unrelated preference changed (#21, PR #650) -- thanks @sgon00 for the report! - Fix Mermaid flowchart node labels being clipped when the preview is zoomed below 100% (#35, PR #657) -- thanks @besi and @rcuisnier for the report! - Fix a reopened never-saved document reporting no text and no unsaved changes before its editor exists, so it no longer saves empty (#586, PR #656) -- thanks @fpservant for the report! - Fix "Restore Editor Pane" never appearing, and the pane staying hidden, after a split pane was collapsed by a divider drag or a restored layout (#649, PR #658) -- thanks @rjoz for the report! - Give GitHub-theme headings a line height proportional to their size so wrapped heading lines no longer collide (#575, PR #634) -- thanks @richb-hanover for the report! thanks @zydon69 for the contribution! - Fix the GitHub-2020 preview style rendering with no paragraph spacing, invisible horizontal rules, uncoloured table and blockquote borders, and black code and blockquote text, by declaring the Primer color and spacing tokens the stylesheet references; tables in that style now size to their content (#633, PR #637) - Fix preference-pane checkbox titles clipping in French and Italian by giving each pane 3% width slack, and fix the General pane's last Behavior row overlapping the row above it (#530, #397, #579, PR #663, PR #667) -- thanks @rcuisnier for the report! - Fix an exception when importing malformed `.textClipping` files, and validate empty pasteboard input (#603, PR #606) -- thanks @zydon69 for the report and the contribution! - Fix Mermaid renders requested while another render is in progress being dropped, and show render errors as text; the Graphviz and Mermaid checkboxes in Settings > Rendering are no longer disabled when syntax highlighting is off (PR #616) -- thanks @zydon69 for the contribution! - Fix terminal launcher installation and removal failing on filesystem errors, existing links and invalid target paths (PR #614) -- thanks @zydon69 for the contribution! - Fix a hang in Homebrew detection when the subprocess writes more output than the pipe buffer holds (PR #621) -- thanks @zydon69 for the contribution! - Ignore Return on directories with Markdown-like names in the folder sidebar (PR #615) -- thanks @zydon69 for the contribution! - Correct several localized labels and the plural rules for the word/character counters in Czech, Ukrainian and Slovak (PR #636) -- thanks @zydon69 for the contribution!
### Security
- Resolve symlinks in the final path component when checking whether a preview navigation stays within the document's folder (PR #610) -- thanks @zydon69 for the contribution!

item.title: MacDown 3000 3000.0.8
item.description:
This release adds folder workspaces, unified document zoom, and draggable table-column resizing, restores automatic update checks, and fixes a batch of preview-rendering, toolbar, export, and scroll-sync bugs.
### Added
- Add draggable table column resizing in the live preview: drag a column-boundary handle to resize live, double-click to reset; widths are held in memory only and reset on full preview reload or document close, with no document mutation (#451, #569) -- thanks @aseelye for the contribution! - Add folder workspaces: browse a folder of Markdown files in a hideable sidebar and open them as native macOS window tabs, via File > Open Folder… or `macdown .` (#493) -- thanks @fluxa (JM Fluxà) for the contribution! - Add unified document zoom: ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 and a toolbar preset dropdown drive one shared zoom level across every open document window, persisting across launches (#529, #518, #470, #335, #552) -- thanks @leevi2010-cursor for the contribution! - Restore automatic update checks and the Check for Updates… menu item, on Sparkle 2 with EdDSA-signed updates (#129, #556, #557)
### Changed
- Reduce "keep/discard" dialogs on external file changes: coalesce rapid write notifications, guard against re-entrant prompts, and reload silently when there are no unsaved edits, preserving caret and scroll position across reloads (#543, #550) -- thanks @Maarten-TL for the report! - Add paragraph and list-item scroll-sync reference points alongside headers/images, and follow the cursor on click and arrow-key moves (not just viewport scroll, and not while typing) when Sync Panes is on, reducing drift in header-sparse sections (#562, #563, #600) -- thanks @macnotes for the contribution!
### Fixed
- Fix heading anchor links copied from GitHub-rendered Markdown not resolving for common headings: heading IDs now strip common punctuation such as em dashes and curly quotes, lowercase Latin-1 letters, and preserve hyphen runs as GitHub does, in the preview, HTML export, and Quick Look (#503, #512) -- thanks @falcon-enoc for the report and the contribution! - Port four low-risk fixes from upstream MacDownApp/macdown#1379: fix a potential crash reaching the editor through a dangling outlet, correct Homebrew detection in the Terminal preferences pane (it never worked — `NSTask` cannot resolve a bare `brew` path), replace deprecated `-insertText:`, and remove stale xib outlet warnings (#526, #528) -- thanks @wltb (Roberto Bissanti) for the contribution! - Fix internal anchor links being lost in exported PDF by injecting PDF link annotations after export, so TOC and heading links are clickable (#504, #516) -- thanks @falcon-enoc for the report! - Fix Mermaid/Graphviz diagrams not rendering in the live preview when Syntax Highlighting is off (#533, #540) -- thanks @AgardnerAU for the report and the contribution! - Fix Mermaid/Graphviz diagrams not rendering in HTML export when "include highlighting" is off, the export-path counterpart of the preview fix above (#541, #542) - Add `img { max-width: 100% }` to the four bundled themes that lacked it (Clearness, Clearness Dark, Solarized Dark, Solarized Light), preventing wide images from overflowing the preview pane (#546, #547) -- thanks @versuchshaus (Stephan von Lingelsheim) for the contribution! - Fix bundled preview stylesheet fixes never reaching users who had already launched the app once; the user Styles directory is now an override layer with bundle fallback instead of a one-time copy (#548, #555) - Fix grouped toolbar buttons (Shift Left/Right, Bold, Italic, Underline, Heading 1-3, lists) visibly depressing but doing nothing — a regression in the click-dispatch selector lookup (#566, #567) -- thanks @massimo-cassandro for the report! thanks @stephane-bg for confirming! - Omit an empty `<thead>` from pipe tables whose header row has no content (#558, #559) -- thanks @macnotes for the contribution! - Stop copy/cut from advertising a file-representable pasteboard type, which caused Messages.app to paste an attached `.md` file instead of inline text (#571, #572) -- thanks @Paraphraser for the report!
### Known Issues
- In Settings → Rendering, the "Syntax highlighted code block" checkbox can overlap the CSS row (#579). Fixed for 3000.0.9.
